prompt: Draw a macOS menu-bar (tray) icon meaning "all tasks done": a circle with a check mark. Write tray.svg: viewBox 0 0 16 16, vector shapes only (no images, text or scripts), a single colour so it works as a template image.

references.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16">
 <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
 <path d="M5 8.5 7 10.5 11 5.5" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>

checks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('tray.svg','utf8');if(!/<svg[^>]*viewBox=.0 0 16 16./.test(s))throw Error('viewBox 0 0 16 16 expected');if(/<image|<script|<text/.test(s))throw Error('vector shapes only');if(!/<(path|circle|rect|polygon|line)/.test(s))throw Error('no shapes');const c=new Set((s.match(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}/g)||[]).map(x=>x.toLowerCase()));if(c.size>1)throw Error('one colour expected for a template icon')"
